title: Craft the Spire [Public Beta]
description:
Craft the Spire — 方块生存题材内容扩展

5 张可收集无色牌、4 张临时矿物牌、4 件共享遗物、1 个事件：废弃矿井。支持简体中文与英文。

Mine temporary resources, use coal and iron for tempo, and chase rare diamonds.

Development build 0.1.0. Target: Slay the Spire 2 public-beta 0.111.0. Requires RitsuLib 0.6.2.
Multiplayer and save/load validation remain pending. Stable branch is not supported.

Unofficial fan-made mod. Not affiliated with Mojang, Microsoft or Mega Crit. Original generated artwork; no extracted game textures or sounds.
changeNote: Initial development build. See the validation checklist before public release.
